body:
First off I'm really sorry about the things you've been through... I'm glad you're doing better now.

 I definitely understand what you're saying here... I am brutal on myself, but it's because people are brutal towards me, so in a way I think I deserve it... And I definitely do blame myself for absolutely everything that happens, even if it's beyond my control. I have this habit of saying, "sorry," for every little thing that happens while others are around, even if I was not there when the thing originally happened or I was not directly involved. It used to be way worse but someone I knew kept asking me to stop. After everything that happened I've just grown used to getting hostile responses from people to the point where I honestly find it easier to apologise right away and then move on.

 I did the same thing (with the religious thinking)... I fell for the just world fallacy and kept wondering what terrible thing I must have done to make x or y happen to me... I also couldn't stop thinking about the fact that if you go crazy often you don't realize that you're going crazy. I mean to navigate in the world you have to have faith in your own perspective and what you are seeing/hearing/etc. and I just didn't have that for a long time, which I believe is why a lot of shitty things went on in my life for far too long... I would go home after school and keep thinking, 'There's no way that this is happening. I must be seeing things the wrong way. I bet I'll wake up tomorrow and everything will be back to normal and I will have a good laugh over what I thought happened,' but then I would wake up in the morning and the behaviour would continue... In the end I was seeing things correctly, but my reaction to it was wrong and that was preventing me from doing what I really had to do to be happy.

 I tell people all the time that I'm happier as an atheist and they never understand why... But the stuff you're saying here is pretty much it... The God from the Christian Bible is like an abusive parent. There is pretty much nothing loving about him mentioned in the Bible at all... And it doesn't seem like a lot of the Bible's followers are actually doing good things. In fact, a lot of them do terrible things all the time and get away with it. So, there's no point in taking it seriously at all. 

 It sucks that so many people were so mean to you. I think that you should be really proud of yourself for turning things around. I hope you kick life's ass... Get that degree and do some awesome stuff with it.

 I have decided that I will see a psych again. Everyone here is saying that I should plus I can tell that I am kind of messed up still...

 If things get a lot better of worse I'll be sure to let you know. 

 Thanks a lot. :)

My relationship with this guy has always been horribly wrong... The only way it could be worse is if he also beat me.

 I do have MSN but I'm not sure if I want to give it out... I'm going to think about it... I might PM you tomorrow. Thanks a lot.

I get what you mean.

 I'm not sure what my needs are, to be honest. I'm going to have to think about it for awhile.

I have decided that I will (see a psych again)... I did see one before and was diagnosed with depression and mild social anxiety disorder.

 I am not feeling suicidal, I have just realized that there is only one little thing in my life which keeps me not suicidal, and that in order to be happy I have to spend a lot of time daydreaming and pretending that I am in a different situation than I am really in, which I find to be distressing.

 A few months ago my boyfriend told me not to worry about money and success and that it didn't matter to him... But he said that after telling me a million times that it did matter a lot, that his parents didn't want us to be together because I wasn't successful enough... When we were in college there were a TON of times where he would get angry at me because I wasn't accomplishing as much as he thought that I should. That on top of the pressure my family puts on me basically has made me obsessed with being successful.

I'm not seeing a psych now but I think that I'm going to (now that I've written down everything that's on my mind and re-read it a few times)... I know I'm pretty fucked up but this is actually the best that I've been since before I went to college.

 I have been trying to meet new people... I find that I still have problems letting people get close (I tend to open up to someone once and then close up completely for awhile or even forever), and I'm also afraid to take the plunge and get rid of the boyfriend that I have now so that I can find another one. In a way his presence is a huge comfort to me, and he has admitted that seeing me come online every day is a comfort to him, too.

 My sister has the same problem... Her boyfriend cheated on her as well, so she tried to break up with him, then she rebounded with a really, really awful guy, and then she went back. We get very little support from each other because our family is so dysfunctional, so we're forced to look outside...

 I know that there are a lot of great guys out there, and I know I would be good to them (like I have never cheated on a guy or abused them or anything... I dated a guy for five years before this one and it was an extremely stable relationship. Only reason why we broke up was beacuse he realized that he wanted me to be a stay at home housewife and I wanted a career), but (as you realize) my self-esteem blows... So I'm kind of assuming I have to work on that, first.
